# Lobe Icons brand assets

The seven SVGs in `apps/public/provider-logos/` are selected from
`@lobehub/icons-static-svg` version **1.95.1**, distributed by
[Lobe Icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons) under the MIT license
(included in `LICENSE`). Brand names and trademarks belong to their owners.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@lobehub/icons-static-svg/-/icons-static-svg-1.95.1.tgz
Tarball SHA-1: `7c6281bf457230b5cfc3b7c2cdd15d3b8d8ab479`

| Provider ID | Source SVG |
| --- | --- |
| deepseek | deepseek-color.svg |
| openai | openai.svg |
| anthropic | anthropic.svg |
| gemini | gemini-color.svg |
| qwen | qwen-color.svg |
| moonshot | moonshot.svg |
| zai | zai.svg |

Assets retain their original paths, colors, and viewBox. The portal serves them
locally and displays them with `object-fit: contain`, beside provider names.
Custom protocols and unknown provider IDs use the existing generic plug icon.
